cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)   # find_library/find_path ... REQUIRED needs 3.18

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vita GDAT Proto - Finale archive compatibility prototype (Phase 9).
#
# Separate project, separate build directory (build-gdatproto/), separate
# title ID VDNG00004. The Phase 8 modules (resproto/src) and the shared
# UI/input modules (src/) are compiled UNMODIFIED from their own locations.
#
# It reads only the synthetic fixtures generated by
# tools/make_gdatproto_fixtures.py (path allowlist in gp_common.c). It does
# not read Mary Skelter files and claims no compatibility with them.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE)
  if(DEFINED ENV{VITASDK})
    set(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE "$ENV{VITASDK}/share/vita.toolchain.cmake" CACHE PATH "VitaSDK toolchain file")
  elseif(EXISTS "/usr/local/vitasdk/share/vita.toolchain.cmake")
    set(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE "/usr/local/vitasdk/share/vita.toolchain.cmake" CACHE PATH "VitaSDK toolchain file")
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "VitaSDK not found. Set VITASDK or pass -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE.")
  endif()
endif()

project(VitaGdatProto C CXX)   # CXX only for linking libvitaGL's C++ objects

include("${VITASDK}/share/vita.cmake" REQUIRED)

set(VITA_APP_NAME "Vita GDAT Proto")
set(VITA_TITLEID  "VDNG00004")
set(VITA_VERSION  "01.00")

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)

find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED CONFIG)

get_filename_component(PROJECT_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
set(RP_SRC "${PROJECT_ROOT}/resproto/src")

# zlib: VitaSDK package "zlib" (installed with vdpm in Phase 8).
find_library(ZLIB_LIB z REQUIRED)
find_path(ZLIB_INC zlib.h REQUIRED)

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures/expected.txt")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "fixtures missing: run python3 -I tools/make_gdatproto_fixtures.py (build_gdatproto.sh does this)")
endif()

# Package only the synthetic fixtures named in the Vita runtime manifest.
# expected.json is used by the PC checker only; the app reads expected.txt.
set(GP_REQUIRED_FIXTURES
  expected.txt
  v_small.gdat
  v_small.csh
  v_medium.gdat
  v_medium.csh
  v_single.gdat
  v_single.csh
  perf.gdat
  perf.csh
  index4096.gdat
  g_bad_magic.gdat
  g_short_header.gdat
  g_empty_file.gdat
  g_index_past_eof.gdat
  g_data_truncated.gdat
  g_offset_in_index.gdat
  g_entry_past_end.gdat
  g_wrap32.gdat
  g_overlap.gdat
  g_unsorted.gdat
  g_gap.gdat
  g_gap_after_index.gdat
  g_trailing.gdat
  g_huge_count.gdat
  g_zero.gdat
  g_zero_trailing.gdat
  w_cases.gdat
  c_bad_magic.csh
  c_field.csh
  c_flagbyte.csh
  c_csize.csh
  c_pair.csh
  c_corrupt.csh
  c_truncated.csh
  c_short.csh
)

set(GP_FIXTURE_VPK_ARGS)
foreach(fixture IN LISTS GP_REQUIRED_FIXTURES)
  set(fixture_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures/${fixture}")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${fixture_source}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${fixture_source}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "Required synthetic Vita GDAT Proto fixture is missing or not a file: ${fixture_source}")
  endif()
  list(APPEND GP_FIXTURE_VPK_ARGS FILE "${fixture_source}" "fixtures/${fixture}")
endforeach()

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME}
  src/gp_main.c
  src/gp_common.c
  src/gp_gdat.c
  src/gp_wrap.c
  src/gp_csh.c
  src/gp_manifest.c
  src/gp_tests.c
  src/gp_report.c
  # Phase 8 modules (unmodified)
  ${RP_SRC}/rp_io.c
  ${RP_SRC}/rp_mem.c
  ${RP_SRC}/rp_inflate.c
  ${RP_SRC}/rp_time.c
  # shared modules (unmodified)
  ${PROJECT_ROOT}/src/graphics/hud2d.c
  ${PROJECT_ROOT}/src/input/input.c
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
  ${RP_SRC}
  ${PROJECT_ROOT}/src
  ${ZLIB_INC}
)

target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  SDL2::SDL2-static
  ${ZLIB_LIB}
  SceSysmem_stub      # sceKernelGetFreeMemorySize (rp_mem snapshots)
)
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)

vita_create_self(eboot.bin ${PROJECT_NAME})

# LiveArea art reuses the project's original placeholder images.
vita_create_vpk(${PROJECT_NAME}.vpk ${VITA_TITLEID} eboot.bin
  VERSION ${VITA_VERSION}
  NAME    ${VITA_APP_NAME}
  FILE    ${PROJECT_ROOT}/sce_sys/icon0.png                        sce_sys/icon0.png
  FILE    ${PROJECT_ROOT}/sce_sys/livearea/contents/bg.png         sce_sys/livearea/contents/bg.png
  FILE    ${PROJECT_ROOT}/sce_sys/livearea/contents/startup.png    sce_sys/livearea/contents/startup.png
  FILE    ${PROJECT_ROOT}/sce_sys/livearea/contents/template.xml   sce_sys/livearea/contents/template.xml
  ${GP_FIXTURE_VPK_ARGS}
)
